title: Breadcrumbs
description: Where you are, as a path. The last crumb is the current page, shown as plain text.
usage: For hierarchies three levels or deeper. Keep crumb names short; if the path gets long, collapse the middle on small screens rather than wrapping.
a11y: A <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> with an ordered list; the current page is plain text with aria-current="page". Separators are decorative (aria-hidden) and mirror in RTL so they point toward the current page. Beta until a recorded screen-reader pass.
